top_signals.title: Bessent Says More Steps Possible on Yen as Trump Praises Japan
top_signals.summary: US Treasury Scott Bessent said that the US stepped in to help fight “disorderly” movements in the yen and is ready to keep helping Japan, while President Donald Trump said the currency-market intervention was a sign of friendship with Tokyo.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump says Iran talks to begin Monday after scrapping attack
top_signals.summary: The U.S. president said that the Saudi crown prince told him over the weekend that he preferred continued talks to the planned strikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Felons, Fraudsters Flog Offensive Cybersecurity Startup
top_signals.summary: A cybersecurity startup dangling millions of dollars to acquire zero-day security vulnerabilities in popular software is run by a pair of far-right conspiracy theorists and convicted felons whose most recent ventures included fake intelligence companies and a now-defunct AI-based lobbying platform they operated under assumed names.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FCA crypto crackdown will ‘wipe out’ bad actors, says Coinbase boss
top_signals.summary: The financial watchdog’s clampdown on digital assets will remove bad actors and attract more customers, The UK boss of one of the world’s largest crypto platforms has said.
